scripts.prepare-assets: npm run grain && npm run audio
scripts.render: npm run prepare-assets && tsx scripts/render.ts Pulse out/pulse-1080p30.mp4
scripts.render:vertical: npm run prepare-assets && tsx scripts/render.ts PulseVertical out/pulse-vertical-1080x1920.mp4
scripts.render:4k60: npm run prepare-assets && tsx scripts/render.ts Pulse out/pulse-4k60.mp4 --scale=2 --fps=60
scripts.render:cli: npm run prepare-assets && remotion render Pulse out/pulse-1080p30.mp4
